name: Gabriel
source:
One of the "Usagi Tenshi" working under the goddess. She pretends to be everyone's older sister.

She has a laid-back nature and often has affectionate behavior. She is kind, but she has a hard-to-understand personality.

"Oh, don't do it, young lady!"

[Translated from [https://mo-623-mo.amebaownd.com/posts/22701112]official website[/url]]
